en.s: The siege of Vilnius occurred in 1390 from 11 September to 7 October. The forces of Grand Duke Vytautas, assisted by the Teutonic Order, besieged Vilnius which was defended by Polish, Lithuanian, and Ruthenian forces under Skirgaila's command. The besiegers managed to destroy the Crooked Castle, which was never rebuilt. However, after almost five weeks of battle, the invading forces decided to retreat due to the poor incoming weather and supply concerns.

zh.s: 1390年9月11日至10月7日，维陶塔斯大公在条顿骑士团协助下围攻维尔纽斯。城内由斯基尔盖拉指挥的波兰、立陶宛和鲁塞尼亚军队守城。围攻者摧毁了曲堡，此后该城堡再未重建。经过近五周战斗，入侵军因天气将变坏且担心补给不足，决定撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Modon was fought on 7 October 1403 between the fleets of the Republic of Venice and of the Republic of Genoa, then under French control, commanded by the French marshal Jean Le Maingre, better known as Boucicaut. One of the last clashes in the Venetian–Genoese wars, the battle ended in a decisive Venetian victory.

zh.s: 1403年10月7日，威尼斯共和国舰队与热那亚共和国舰队在莫东交战。当时热那亚受法国控制，舰队由法国元帅让·勒曼格尔指挥，他更广为人知的名字是布西科。这是威尼斯—热那亚战争中的最后几场交锋之一，最终威尼斯获胜。

en.s: The Battle of La Motta, also known as the Battle of Schio, Battle of Vicenza or Battle of Creazzo, took place at Schio, in the Italian region of Veneto, Republic of Venice, on 7 October 1513, between the forces of the Republic of Venice and a combined force of Spain and the Holy Roman Empire, and was a significant battle of the War of the League of Cambrai. A Venetian army under Bartolomeo d'Alviano was decisively defeated by the Spanish/Imperial army commanded by Ramón de Cardona and Fernando d'Avalos.

zh.s: 拉莫塔战役又称斯基奥战役、维琴察战役或克雷阿佐战役，1513年10月7日发生在威尼斯共和国辖下意大利威尼托大区的斯基奥。威尼斯共和国军队与西班牙和神圣罗马帝国联军交战。这是康布雷同盟战争中的一场重要战役。巴托洛梅奥·达尔维亚诺率领的威尼斯军队被拉蒙·德·卡尔多纳和费尔南多·达瓦洛斯指挥的西班牙—帝国联军彻底击败。

en.s: The Battle of Tughlaqabad (also known as the Battle of Delhi) was a notable battle fought on 7 October 1556 between a Hindu general of the Sur known as Hemu and the forces of the Mughal Emperor Akbar led by Tardi Beg Khan at Tughlaqabad near Delhi. The battle ended in a victory for Hemu, who took possession of Delhi and claimed royal status, assuming the title of Vikramaditya.

zh.s: 1556年10月7日，苏尔王朝的印度教将领赫穆与莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴麾下的军队在德里附近的图格拉卡巴德交战。莫卧儿军由塔尔迪·贝格·汗指挥。战役以赫穆获胜告终，他占领德里并自称国王，称号为毗克拉玛蒂亚。

en.s: The Battle of Lepanto was a naval engagement that took place on 7 October 1571 when a fleet of the Holy League, a coalition of Catholic states arranged by Pope Pius V and led by the navies of the Spanish Empire and the Republic of Venice, inflicted a major defeat on the fleet of the Ottoman Empire in the Gulf of Patras.

zh.s: 1571年10月7日，神圣同盟舰队在帕特雷湾与奥斯曼帝国舰队交战。神圣同盟由教宗庇护五世促成，成员为天主教国家，主力是西班牙帝国和威尼斯共和国的海军，最终重创奥斯曼舰队。

en.s: The siege of Navarino was a military engagement between the Holy League fleet, led by John of Austria, who besieged the Ottoman garrison in Navarino as part of an operation to destroy the Ottoman fleet built after the Battle of Lepanto. The operation ended in failure by a variety of reasons, leading to the withdrawal of the Christian armada.

en.s: The Battle of Cecora (also known as the Battle of Țuțora) took place during the Polish–Ottoman War (1620–21) between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth (aided by rebel Moldavian troops) and Ottoman forces (backed by Nogais), fought from 17 September to 7 October 1620 in Moldavia, near the Prut River.

zh.s: 采切拉战役又称图图拉战役，是波兰—奥斯曼战争（1620至1621年）中的一场战役。波兰立陶宛联邦军队得到摩尔达维亚叛军协助，与奥斯曼军队交战；奥斯曼军队则有诺盖人支持。战斗于1620年9月17日至10月7日在摩尔达维亚、普鲁特河附近进行。

en.s: The Battle of Lleida took place on 7 October 1642, during the Catalan Revolt, part of the wider Franco-Spanish War (1635–1659). A combined Franco-Catalan army under Philippe de La Mothe-Houdancourt defeated a larger Spanish force led by Marquis de Leganés, sent to capture the town of Lleida.

zh.s: 1642年10月7日，莱里达战役在加泰罗尼亚起义期间爆发，后者是1635至1659年法西战争的一部分。菲利普·德·拉莫特-乌当库尔率领的法加联军击败了兵力更强的西班牙军队。西军由莱加内斯侯爵指挥，奉命攻占莱里达。

en.s: The attack on Narva occurred from 5 to 7 October, 1657, being fought between the garrison in Narva and a Russian force under Ivan Andreyevich Khovansky. The Swedish garrison managed to repel the Russian attack, and the Russians withdrew to Jama on 7 October, later withdrawing all the way to Pskov on 17 October.

zh.s: 1657年10月5日至7日，俄军在伊万·安德烈耶维奇·霍万斯基率领下进攻纳尔瓦，与当地守军交战。瑞典守军击退了俄军。俄军于10月7日撤至亚马村，10月17日又一路撤至普斯科夫。

en.s: The Battle of Kandarpi Ghat occurred between the Nawab of Bengal and Raj Darbhanga in October 1753. Raj Darbhanga headed by Maithil Brahmin king Maharaja Narendra Singh clashed against forces of Bengal Subah led by Bhikhari Mahtha, an official of Alivardi Khan and emerged victorious.

zh.s: 1753年10月，孟加拉纳瓦卜与达尔班加王公国之间爆发坎达尔皮河坛之战。由迈蒂利婆罗门国王纳伦德拉·辛格大君领导的达尔班加军队，与阿里瓦尔迪·汗手下官员比卡里·马哈塔率领的孟加拉苏巴军队交战并获胜。

en.s: The Battles of Saratoga were fought September 19 and October 7, 1777 over the same ground by the American Continental Army and the British Army near Saratoga, New York during the American Revolutionary War. The second battle ended with a decisive American victory, and the surrender of the British army there. The outcome greatly affected the course of the war, persuading France to enter the war as an American ally.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，大陆军与英军于1777年9月19日和10月7日在纽约州萨拉托加附近的同一片区域交战。第二场战斗以大陆军大胜、英军投降告终。战果深刻影响了战争进程，并促使法国成为美国的盟友。

en.s: The Battle of Kings Mountain was a decisive victory in South Carolina for the Patriot militia over the Loyalist militia in the Southern campaign of the American Revolutionary War. The battle took place on October 7, 1780, 9 miles (14 km) south of the present-day town of Kings Mountain, North Carolina in rural Cherokee County, South Carolina, where the Patriot militia defeated the Loyalist militia commanded by British Major Patrick Ferguson of the 71st Foot. Ferguson had arrived in North Carolina in early September 1780 to recruit troops for the Loyalist militia and protect the flank of Lord Cornwallis' main force.

zh.s: 金斯山战役是美国独立战争南方战事中的一场关键胜利，爱国者民兵击败了效忠派民兵。战役于1780年10月7日发生在南卡罗来纳州乡村地区的切罗基县，距今天的北卡罗来纳州金斯山镇以南9英里（14公里）。爱国者民兵击败了由英国第71步兵团少校帕特里克·弗格森指挥的效忠派民兵。弗格森于1780年9月上旬抵达北卡罗来纳州，为效忠派民兵招募士兵，并保护康沃利斯勋爵主力部队的侧翼。

en.s: The Battle of the Levant Convoy was a naval engagement of the War of the First Coalition fought on 7 October 1795. During the battle, a powerful French squadron surprised a valuable British convoy from the Levant off Cape St. Vincent on the coast of Portugal. The convoy was weakly defended, and although the small escort squadron tried to drive the French back, they were outmatched.

zh.s: 1795年10月7日，第一次反法同盟战争期间爆发黎凡特船队海战。一支强大的法国舰队在葡萄牙海岸的圣文森特角附近，突袭了一支来自黎凡特地区、载有贵重货物的英国船队。船队防卫薄弱，尽管规模较小的护航舰队试图击退法军，但仍不敌对方。

en.s: Suvorov's Swiss campaign took place on Swiss territory between September and October 1799 during the War of the Second Coalition. Russo-Austrian troops, who had already repeatedly defeated the French in Italy between April and August, crossed St. Gotthard under the command of Field Marshal Alexander Vasilyevich Suvorov-Rymniksky, with orders to march against General André Masséna to drive him out of the Helvetic Republic.

zh.s: 苏沃洛夫瑞士战役于1799年9月至10月在瑞士境内进行，属于第二次反法同盟战争的一部分。俄奥军队此前已在4月至8月间于意大利多次击败法军，随后在亚历山大·瓦西里耶维奇·苏沃洛夫-雷姆尼克斯基元帅指挥下越过圣哥达山口，奉命向安德烈·马塞纳将军进军，将其逐出赫尔维蒂共和国。

en.t: 1800 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1800 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on October 7, 1800. The incumbent Representative and House Minority Leader James A. Bayard Sr. won reelection and defeated the former Representative John Patten, who would die later that year.

en.s: The Battle of Donauwörth was the first engagement of Napoleon's 1805 Austrian campaign. French forces under marshals Joachim Murat and Nicolas Soult beat an Austrian army corps under Kienmayer on 7 October at Donauwörth and crossed the Danube.

zh.s: 1805年奥地利战役中的首次交战发生在多瑙沃特。10月7日，约阿希姆·缪拉和尼古拉·苏尔特元帅率领的法军击败了金迈尔指挥的奥军军团，并渡过多瑙河。

en.t: 1806 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 1806 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on October 7, 1806, to elect the U.S. representative from Delaware's at-large congressional district. Incumbent Federalist James M. Broom faced re-election to a full term after winning the previous year's special election. He was challenged by three Democratic-Republicans. Broom was re-elected with over 60% of the vote, with neither opponent coming close to unseating him.

zh.t: 1806年美国特拉华州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1806年10月7日，特拉华州举行联邦众议员选举，选出该州单一国会选区的众议员。联邦党现任众议员詹姆斯·M·布鲁姆在前一年赢得特别选举后，此次竞选完整任期。他面对三名民主共和党候选人的挑战，最终以超过60%的选票连任，对手都未能接近击败他。

en.s: In the Battle of the Bidasoa (or the Battle of Larrun) on 7 October 1813 the Allied army of Arthur Wellesley, Marquess of Wellington wrested a foothold on French soil from Nicolas Soult's French army. The Allied troops overran the French lines behind the Bidassoa River on the coast and along the Pyrenees crest between the Bidasoa and La Rhune (Larrun). The nearest towns to the fighting are Irun on the lower Bidassoa and Bera on the middle Bidasoa. The battle occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the wider Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1813年10月7日，比达索阿河战役（又称拉伦战役）中，威灵顿侯爵阿瑟·韦尔斯利率领的盟军在法国境内取得立足点，击退尼古拉·苏尔特率领的法军。盟军越过比达索阿河后方的法军防线，突破了海岸一带以及比达索阿河与拉伦山之间比利牛斯山脊上的防线。距离战场最近的城镇，是比达索阿河下游的伊伦和中游的贝拉。此战发生在半岛战争期间；半岛战争是更广泛的拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.s: The 1823 Delaware gubernatorial special election was held on October 7, 1823. A few months into his three-year term, Democratic-Republican Governor Joseph Haslet died in office, elevating State Senate Speaker Charles Thomas to the governorship and triggering a special election in 1823. Justice of the Peace David Hazzard ran as the Democratic-Republican nominee to succeed Thomas and faced State Senator Samuel Paynter, the Federalist nominee.

zh.s: 1823年10月7日，特拉华州举行州长特别选举。民主共和党籍州长约瑟夫·哈斯莱特在三年任期开始数月后病逝，州参议院议长查尔斯·托马斯继任州长，并因此触发1823年的特别选举。治安法官戴维·哈扎德作为民主共和党候选人参选，挑战他的是联邦党候选人、州参议员塞缪尔·佩恩特。

en.s: The Morea expedition (French: Expédition de Morée) is the name given to the land intervention of the French Army in the Peloponnese between 1828 and 1833, at the time of the Greek War of Independence, with the aim of expelling the Ottoman-Egyptian occupation forces from the region. It was also accompanied by a scientific expedition mandated by the French Academy.
en.n: Morea expedition: The city of Patras, Greece, is liberated by the French expeditionary force.

zh.s: 莫里亚远征是指1828年至1833年希腊独立战争期间，法国陆军在伯罗奔尼撒半岛展开的地面军事行动，目的是驱逐该地区的奥斯曼—埃及占领军。法国科学院还派出一支科学考察队随行。

en.s: The Surrender at Ozora, was an important event of the early stage of the Hungarian War of independence of 1848-1849. The 9,000 strong Croatian corps which invaded the Transdanubia region of Hungary, trying to join the Croatian main army led by Lieutenant General Josip Jelačić, which was sent by the Habsburg Empire to chase away the revolutionary government of Hungary, and reimpose the total imperial suvereignity over the country, was forced to surrender by Hungarian regular and insurrectionist forces led by Major Artúr Görgei and Colonel Mór Perczel.

zh.s: 奥佐拉投降是1848至1849年匈牙利独立战争初期的重要事件。9000人的克罗地亚军团入侵匈牙利外多瑙地区，试图与约西普·耶拉契奇中将率领的克罗地亚主力会合。哈布斯堡帝国派耶拉契奇追击匈牙利革命政府、恢复帝国对匈牙利的全面统治。最终，阿尔图尔·格尔盖少校和莫尔·佩采尔上校率领的匈牙利正规军及起义军迫使克罗地亚军团投降。

en.s: The 1861 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on October 7, 1861, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Governor John J. Pettus, a Democrat, won against Democrat Jacob Thompson and moderate Democrat Madison McAfee. Amid the start of the Civil War, Governor John J. Pettus faced internal party challenges and criticisms for military handling. Despite discontent and potential withdrawal, Pettus persisted with the campaign.

zh.s: 1861年10月7日，密西西比州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长约翰·J·佩特斯击败民主党人雅各布·汤普森和温和派民主党人麦迪逊·麦卡菲。南北战争刚开始时，佩特斯因党内对手及军事事务处理方式受到批评。尽管面对不满和可能退选的压力，他仍继续参选。

en.s: The Battle of Farmington, Tennessee was fought October 7, 1863 in Farmington, Marshall County, Tennessee as part of Confederate Major General Joseph Wheeler's October 1863 Raid in the American Civil War. The battle was fought as Wheeler was retreating back to the Confederate lines. Following a Union cavalry charge, the Confederates were routed, with an entire regiment deserting.

en.s: The Battle of Darbytown and New Market Roads ( or Johnson's Farm or Four Mile Creek) was an engagement between Union and Confederate forces during the American Civil War, which took place on October 7, 1864, in Henrico County, Virginia, as part of the Richmond-Petersburg Campaign.

en.t: USS Wachusett captures CSS Florida in Bahia
en.s: Before dawn on October 7, 1864, the Union warship Wachusett captured the Confederate vessel Florida in the port of Bahia, now Salvador, Brazil.
en.n: Brazil protested the seizure in its neutral port.

zh.t: “瓦楚塞特”号在巴伊亚港俘获“佛罗里达”号
zh.s: 1864年10月7日黎明前，美国联邦海军军舰“瓦楚塞特”号在巴西巴伊亚港俘获南方邦联舰艇“佛罗里达”号。巴伊亚港即今天的萨尔瓦多。
zh.n: 巴西抗议美舰在其中立港口实施抓捕。

en.s: On October 7, 1868, Cornell University held its inauguration ceremonies in Ithaca, New York.
en.n: The university had been established by law in 1865; this date records its inauguration.

zh.t: 康奈尔大学举行开校典礼
zh.s: 1868年10月7日，康奈尔大学在美国纽约州伊萨卡举行开校典礼。
zh.n: 该校于1865年依法设立，这里记录的是开校典礼的日期。

en.s: The Battle of Bellevue on 7 October 1870 was fought during the Franco-Prussian War and ended in a Prussian victory. The French forces under Marshal François Achille Bazaine attempted to break through the lines of the Prussians investing Metz. They were unsuccessful and were driven back into the city with a loss of 1,300 men, including 71 officers. The Prussians lost 1,800 men, including 79 officers.

zh.s: 1870年10月7日，普法战争期间爆发贝尔维尤战役，普军获胜。法军元帅弗朗索瓦·阿希尔·巴赞率军试图突破围困梅斯的普军防线，但未能成功，被击退至城内，损失1300人，其中包括71名军官。普军损失1800人，其中包括79名军官。

zh.s: 1904年10月7日，英国议会塔内特岛选区举行补选，此前保守党议员詹姆斯·劳瑟去世。保守党候选人哈里·马克斯成功保住该党席位。

The match decided the winner of 1906 Svenska Mästerskapet, the football cup to determine the Swedish champions. Örgryte IS won their eighth title with a 4–3 victory at Idrottsparken in Stockholm.

zh.s: 1906年10月7日，第九次闯入决赛的厄格里特体育会对阵第二次进入决赛的佐加顿斯体育会，争夺1906年瑞典锦标赛冠军。这项足球杯赛旨在决出瑞典冠军。厄格里特体育会在斯德哥尔摩的伊德罗茨帕肯球场以4比3获胜，拿下队史第八个冠军。

en.s: The 1906 Argentine Primera División final was the playoff that determined the winner of 1906 season of Argentine Primera División. It was contested by Alumni and Lomas Athletic Club (winners of groups B and A respectively), in order to decide a champion. It was the first league final contested by Alumni while Lomas played their second final since 1897 when they had won the championship after beating Lanús A.C. after three games.

zh.s: 1906年阿根廷甲级联赛决赛是决定该赛季冠军的附加赛，由B组冠军阿尔米纳队对阵A组冠军洛马斯竞技俱乐部。阿尔米纳队首次闯入联赛决赛；洛马斯竞技俱乐部则是第二次进入决赛。他们上一次是在1897年对阵拉努斯竞技俱乐部，三场比赛后赢得冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Jabassi or Battle of Yabassi was a pair of assaults on German positions at Jabassi on the Wuri river during the Kamerun campaign of World War I between German and British forces on 7 and 14 October 1914. The action resulted in British victory and their occupation of the station.

zh.s: 雅巴西战役又称亚巴西战役，是第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役期间英德双方围绕乌里河畔雅巴西德军阵地发动的两次进攻，分别发生于1914年10月7日和14日。英军获胜并占领了该据点。

en.t: German and Austro-Hungarian infantry attack Belgrade
en.s: On the morning of October 7, 1915, German and Austro-Hungarian infantry began crossing the rivers around Belgrade to attack the Serbian capital.
en.n: The infantry assault followed artillery bombardment that had begun on October 5.

zh.t: 德国和奥匈步兵向贝尔格莱德发动进攻
zh.s: 1915年10月7日清晨，德国和奥匈帝国步兵开始渡过贝尔格莱德周边的河流，进攻塞尔维亚首都。
zh.n: 步兵进攻前，炮击已于10月5日开始。

en.s: The Capture of Le Sars (7 October 1916) was a tactical incident during the Battle of the Somme. Le Sars is a commune in the Pas-de-Calais department in the Nord-Pas-de-Calais region of France. The village lies along the Albert–Bapaume road. The village is situated 16 mi (26 km) south of Arras, at the junction of the D 11 and the D 929 roads.

zh.s: 1916年10月7日，协约国夺取勒萨尔村，这是索姆河战役中的一次战术行动。勒萨尔是法国加来海峡省的一个市镇，位于阿尔贝—巴波姆公路沿线，距阿拉斯以南16英里（26公里），处于D11公路和D929公路交汇处。

en.t: 1916 Cumberland vs. Georgia Tech football game
en.s: The 1916 Cumberland vs. Georgia Tech football game was played on October 7, 1916, between the Cumberland College Bulldogs and the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets on the Yellow Jackets' home field of Grant Field in Atlanta. Georgia Tech defeated the Bulldogs 222–0 for the highest and most one-sided score in the history of college football.

zh.t: 1916年坎伯兰学院对阵佐治亚理工学院橄榄球赛
zh.s: 1916年坎伯兰学院斗牛犬队与佐治亚理工学院黄夹克队的比赛于1916年10月7日在亚特兰大举行，场地是黄夹克队主场格兰特球场。佐治亚理工学院以222比0获胜，这是大学橄榄球史上分差最大、比分最悬殊的比赛。

en.s: The Battle of Port-au-Prince took place on either the 6 or 7 October 1919 when Haitian rebels, known as Cacos, attacked the capital of Haiti during the Second Caco War and the American occupation of Haiti. The assault began at 4:00 a.m., with between 200 and 300 Cacos, armed with "swords, machetes, and pikes" and commanded by Charlemagne Masséna Péralte, entering the city from the North, only to be met by fearsome rifle and machine gun fire from the American Marines and Haitian gendarmes garrisoning the city.

zh.s: 太子港之战发生在1919年10月6日或7日。当时海地正处于第二次卡科战争和美国占领时期，称为卡科人的海地反叛者袭击了首都。袭击于凌晨4点开始，200至300名卡科人由夏尔马涅·马塞纳·佩拉尔特指挥，手持“剑、砍刀和长矛”从城北进入，却遭到驻守当地的美国海军陆战队和海地宪兵以步枪和机枪猛烈射击。

en.s: On October 7, 1919, eight Dutch businessmen founded KLM in the Netherlands.
en.n: Its first scheduled route, between Amsterdam and London, opened in May 1920.

zh.t: 荷兰皇家航空公司成立
zh.s: 1919年10月7日，八名荷兰商人共同创立荷兰皇家航空公司（KLM）。
zh.n: 公司于1920年5月开通首条定期航线，往返阿姆斯特丹与伦敦。

en.s: The 1922 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 35th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1922 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Dublin defeated Galway. Sligo had qualified, but were ejected in spectacular circumstances, and also stripped of their Connacht SFC title (given instead to Galway).

zh.t: 1922年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1922年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第35届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1922年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛的决胜场。该赛事是爱尔兰顶级球队参加的跨郡盖尔式足球比赛。都柏林击败戈尔韦夺冠。斯莱戈原本已取得参赛资格，但以戏剧性的方式被取消资格，其康诺特高级足球锦标赛冠军也被剥夺，改由戈尔韦获得。

en.s: The 1929 FA Charity Shield was the 16th FA Charity Shield, an annual football match. It was played between the Professionals and the Amateurs at New Cross in London on 7 October 1929. The Professionals won the match 3–0.

zh.s: 1929年英格兰慈善盾杯是第16届慈善盾杯，这项赛事每年举行一场足球比赛。职业球员队与业余球员队于1929年10月7日在伦敦新十字区交手，职业球员队以3比0获胜。

en.s: The 1931 FA Charity Shield was the 18th FA Charity Shield, a football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup competitions. The match was contested by league champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners West Bromwich Albion, and was played at Villa Park, the home ground of Aston Villa. Arsenal won the game, 1–0.

zh.s: 1931年英格兰慈善盾杯是第18届慈善盾杯，由上赛季英格兰足球甲级联赛和足总杯冠军进行一场比赛。联赛冠军阿森纳对阵足总杯冠军西布罗姆维奇，比赛在阿斯顿维拉主场维拉公园举行。阿森纳以1比0获胜。

en.t: Air France is officially inaugurated at Le Bourget
en.s: On October 7, 1933, French aviation minister Pierre Cot officially inaugurated Air France at Le Bourget airport near Paris.
en.n: The airline had been formed through a merger in August 1933; this date records the official opening ceremony.

zh.t: 法国航空公司在勒布尔热举行启用仪式
zh.s: 1933年10月7日，法国航空部长皮埃尔·科特在巴黎附近的勒布尔热机场主持法国航空公司的启用仪式。
zh.n: 法航已于同年8月通过合并成立，这里记录的是正式启用仪式。

en.t: Japanese troops complete their evacuation of Vella Lavella
en.s: During the night of October 6–7, 1943, Japanese forces evacuated their remaining troops from Vella Lavella in the Solomon Islands, despite an attempt by American destroyers to intercept them.
en.n: This records the evacuation, rather than assigning the whole New Georgia operation to a single end date.

zh.t: 日军完成从韦拉拉韦拉岛撤军
zh.s: 1943年10月6日至7日夜间，日军将剩余部队撤出所罗门群岛的韦拉拉韦拉岛，美军驱逐舰的拦截未能阻止这次撤离。
zh.n: 这里记录的是撤军行动，并非把整个新乔治亚作战都定在这一天结束。

en.s: The Auschwitz Sonderkommando revolt occurred on 7 October 1944, when a large group of Sonderkommando members in the crematoria area of Birkenau camp (also known as Auschwitz II) rebelled against the SS guards of the camp. The revolt was suppressed after Crematorium IV was blown up, killing three guards and 451 members of the Sonderkommando.

zh.t: 奥斯维辛特别行动队起义
zh.s: 1944年10月7日，别克瑙营（又称奥斯维辛二号营）火葬场区域的大批特别行动队成员起义，反抗营内党卫军守卫。火葬场四号被炸毁后，起义遭到镇压，3名守卫和451名特别行动队成员死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Kotabaru (Indonesian: Pertempuran Kotabaru) was a clash between Indonesian nationalists and a Japanese garrison in Yogyakarta on 7 October 1945. The Indonesians launched an attack on the Japanese garrison with the intent of acquiring weapons for use in the war of independence.

zh.s: 1945年10月7日，印度尼西亚民族主义者与驻日军在日惹发生冲突。印尼人袭击了日军驻军，目的是夺取武器，用于独立战争。

en.t: The communist German Democratic Republic (East Germany) is formed
en.s: East Germany, officially the German Democratic Republic (GDR), was a country in Central Europe from its formation on 7 October 1949 until its reunification with West Germany (Federal Republic of Germany) on 3 October 1990. Until 1989, it was generally viewed as a communist state and described itself as a socialist workers' and peasants' state.

zh.t: 德意志民主共和国（东德）成立
zh.s: 东德正式名称为德意志民主共和国（GDR），是一个位于中欧的国家，于1949年10月7日成立，1990年10月3日与西德（德意志联邦共和国）统一。1989年以前，东德普遍被视为共产主义国家，并自称社会主义工农国家。

en.s: The Assassination of Waruhiu was the murder of Kenyan Chief Waruhiu by the Mau Maus on 7 October 1952. The Chief was a supporter of the unwelcomed Colonial British presence in Kenya and was shot in his car; at his funeral, Governor Evelyn Baring called him "a great man, a great African and a great citizen of Kenya, who met his death in the service of his own people and his Government." His death helped lead to the declaration of a State of Emergency in Kenya.

zh.s: 1952年10月7日，茅茅起义者刺杀了肯尼亚酋长瓦鲁希乌。瓦鲁希乌支持英国在肯尼亚的殖民统治，在车内遭枪击身亡。葬礼上，总督伊夫林·巴林称他是“一位伟人、一位伟大的非洲人，也是一位伟大的肯尼亚公民；他为自己的人民和政府效力时遇害”。他的死促成肯尼亚宣布进入紧急状态。

en.s: The 1956 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was a Gaelic football match played at Croke Park on 7 October 1956 to determine the winners of the 1956 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, the 70th season of the All-Ireland Senior Football Championship. The tournament was organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champions of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1956年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1956年10月7日，克罗克公园举行盖尔式足球比赛，决出1956年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛冠军，这是该赛事的第70届。爱尔兰盖尔运动协会组织了这项锦标赛，参赛队伍是爱尔兰四个省的冠军队。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 7 October 1957. The result was a victory for the Labour Party, which won 78 of the 150 seats in the Storting. The Gerhardsen government continued in office.

en.t: Kennedy and Nixon hold their second presidential debate
en.s: On October 7, 1960, John F. Kennedy and Richard Nixon held their second presidential debate at the WRC-TV studios in Washington, D.C.

zh.t: 肯尼迪与尼克松举行第二场总统候选人辩论
zh.s: 1960年10月7日，约翰·肯尼迪与理查德·尼克松在美国华盛顿的WRC电视台演播室举行第二场总统候选人辩论。

en.s: The 1961 Derby Aviation crash refers to the fatal crash of a Douglas Dakota IV, registration G-AMSW, operated by Derby Aviation, a subsidiary of British Midland Airways, on the mountain of Canigou, France, on 7 October 1961. All 34 on board (31 passengers, pilot, co-pilot and stewardess) were killed.

zh.s: 1961年10月7日，英国米德兰航空旗下德比航空运营的一架道格拉斯DC-3（Dakota IV，注册号G-AMSW）在法国卡尼古山坠毁，机上34人（31名乘客、飞行员、副驾驶和空乘人员）全部遇难。

en.t: Kennedy signs the ratification instruments for the Limited Test Ban Treaty
en.s: On October 7, 1963, President John F. Kennedy signed the United States’ instruments of ratification for the Limited Test Ban Treaty.
en.n: The treaty had been signed in Moscow in August and entered into force on October 10, 1963.

zh.t: 肯尼迪签署《部分禁止核试验条约》批准书
zh.s: 1963年10月7日，美国总统约翰·肯尼迪签署美国对《部分禁止核试验条约》的批准书。

en.t: Buddhist crisis: Amid worsening relations, outspoken South Vietnamese First Lady Madame Ngo Dinh Nhu arrives in the US for a speaking tour, continuing a flurry of attacks on the Kennedy administration
en.s: The Buddhist crisis (Vietnamese: Biến cố Phật giáo) was a period of political and religious tension in South Vietnam between May and November 1963, characterized by a series of repressive acts by the South Vietnamese government and a campaign of civil resistance, led mainly by Buddhist activists. The crisis was precipitated by the shootings of nine unarmed civilians on May 8 in the central city of Huế who were protesting against a ban of the Buddhist flag.

zh.t: 佛教危机：南越第一夫人吴廷瑈夫人抵达美国巡回演讲，继续密集抨击肯尼迪政府
zh.s: 佛教危机是1963年5月至11月南越政治和宗教紧张的一段时期，其间南越政府采取了一系列镇压措施，主要由佛教活动人士领导的民间抵抗运动也随之展开。危机起因于5月8日发生在顺化市中心的枪击事件：9名手无寸铁的平民因抗议禁止悬挂佛教旗帜而遭枪击。（越南语：Biến cố Phật giáo）

en.s: Operation Coronado V was a riverine military operation conducted by the U.S. Mobile Riverine Force (MRF) and elements of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam from 12 September to 5 October 1967 in an attempt to shut down Viet Cong (VC) strongholds in the Mekong Delta. en.s: The Chinese Television System Inc. (Chinese: 中華電視公司; pinyin: Zhōnghuá Diànshì Gōngsī; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Tiong-hôa-tiān-sī-kong-si; Zhuyin Fuhao: ㄓㄨㄥ ㄏㄨㄚˊ ㄉㄧㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ) is a terrestrial television station in Taiwan and was founded in 1971. en.s: The Battle of Latakia (Arabic: معركة اللاذقية‎‎; Hebrew: קרב לטקיה‎‎) was a small but revolutionary naval battle of the Yom Kippur War, fought on 7 October 1973, between Israel and Syria. It was the first naval battle in history to see combat between surface-to-surface missile-equipped missile boats and the use of electronic deception. At the outset of hostilities, the Israeli Navy set out to destroy the naval capabilities of the Syrians, who were equipped with Soviet Komar and Osa class missile boats. The Syrian missile-boats were equipped with Soviet manufactured P-15 Termit (NATO reporting name: SS-N-2 Styx) anti-ship missiles with twice the range of the Israeli Gabriel anti-ship missiles.

zh.s: 赎罪日战争期间，1973年10月7日以色列与叙利亚在拉塔基亚交战。这场规模不大却具有开创性的海战，是历史上首次出现装备舰对舰导弹的导弹艇交战，也是首次使用电子欺骗的海战。战事开始时，以色列海军着手摧毁叙利亚海军力量；叙利亚海军装备了苏制“蚊子”级和“黄蜂”级导弹艇。叙利亚导弹艇配备苏联制造的P-15“白蛉”反舰导弹（北约代号SS-N-2“冥河”），射程是以色列“加百列”反舰导弹的两倍。

en.s: Operation Model 5 (Hebrew: דוגמן 5, Doogman 5) is the name of an Israeli Air Force operation, and the common name for the ensuing anti-aircraft battle, which took place over the Golan Heights on the October 7, 1973, the second day of the Yom Kippur War. Model 5 was preplanned as a sweeping operation to destroy all of the Syrian surface-to-air missile (SAM) batteries on the Golan front, by using unguided, general-use bombs dropped from a medium altitude near the targets.

zh.s: 赎罪日战争第二天，即1973年10月7日，以色列空军在戈兰高地上空执行模范5号行动（希伯来语：דוגמן 5，Doogman 5）。该行动也常指随后发生的防空战。以色列事先计划通过全面行动摧毁戈兰战线上的所有叙利亚地对空导弹阵地，做法是让飞机在目标附近的中等高度投放无制导通用炸弹。

en.s: Operation Tagar (Hebrew: תגר, Quarrel) was the name of an Israeli Air Force operation which took place over Egypt on October 7, 1973, the second day of the Yom Kippur War. The operation was preplanned as a sweeping operation to destroy all of the Egyptian surface-to-air missile batteries on the Egyptian front, by using unguided, general-purpose bombs dropped from a medium altitude near the targets.

It took place in the small Egyptian naval anchorage of Marsa Talamat, in the central sector of the Gulf of Suez.

en.s: The 1974 Yukon general election was held on 7 October 1974 to elect the twelve members of the 23rd Yukon Territorial Council. The council consisted of 10 non-partisan and two members elected for the Yukon NDP. It had merely an advisory role to the federally appointed Commissioner for some departments, but had full responsibility for several departments through the appointment of three councillors to an executive committee.

zh.s: 1974年10月7日，育空举行大选，选出第23届育空地区议会的12名议员。议会由10名无党派议员和2名育空新民主党议员组成。议会对联邦任命的专员及部分部门只有咨询职能，但通过任命3名议员组成执行委员会，对其他几个部门拥有完整职责。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 7 October 1975, alongside a simultaneous referendum on presidential term limits. In the presidential election, incumbent William R. Tolbert, Jr. of the True Whig Party (who had taken office after the death of William Tubman in 1971) was the only candidate, and was re-elected unopposed. In the legislative elections True Whig Party candidates won all 71 seats in the House of Representatives unopposed.

zh.s: 1975年10月7日，利比里亚举行大选，并同时就总统任期限制举行公投。总统选举中，真实辉格党现任总统威廉·R·托尔伯特（他在威廉·塔布曼于1971年去世后就任）是唯一候选人，因此未经竞争再次当选。立法选举中，真实辉格党候选人未经竞争赢得众议院全部71席。

en.s: The 1977 Constitution of the Soviet Union, officially the Constitution of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, was the communist state constitution adopted on 7 October 1977. The 1977 Constitution, also known as the Brezhnev Constitution or the Constitution of Developed Socialism, was the third and final constitution of the Soviet Union, adopted unanimously at the 7th (Special) Session of the Ninth Convocation of the Supreme Soviet and signed by Chairman of the Presidium Leonid Brezhnev.

zh.s: 1977年10月7日，苏联通过了共产主义国家宪法，正式名称为《苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟宪法》。该宪法也称勃列日涅夫宪法或“发达社会主义宪法”，是苏联第三部、也是最后一部宪法。它由最高苏维埃第九届任期的第七次特别会议一致通过，并由主席团主席列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫签署。

en.s: A general election was held in the state of New South Wales, Australia, on Saturday 7 October 1978. The result was a landslide victory for the Australian Labor Party under Neville Wran, popularly known as the "Wranslide." It is notable for being so successful for the Labor Party that it tallied 57 percent of the primary vote, the largest primary vote for any party in over a century. Having gone into the election with a razor-thin majority of one seat, Labor scored a 13-seat swing, giving it a strong majority of 63 seats.

zh.s: 1978年10月7日星期六，澳大利亚新南威尔士州举行大选。内维尔·韦兰领导的澳大利亚工党大获全胜，这场胜利后来被称为“韦兰横扫”。工党获得57%的第一偏好票，这是一个多世纪以来任何政党取得的最高比例。工党参选前仅以一个席位勉强过半，最终净增13席，以63席取得稳固多数。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 1080 was a Soviet domestic passenger flight from Sverdlovsk (now Yekaterinburg), Russia, to Dzhambul (now Taraz), Kazakhstan, that crashed at night shortly after takeoff on 7 October 1978. All 38 passengers and crew were killed in the crash which occurred when one of the engines failed due to icing during initial climb out.

zh.s: 1978年10月7日夜间，苏联民航1080号班机从斯维尔德洛夫斯克（今俄罗斯叶卡捷琳堡）飞往江布尔（今哈萨克斯坦塔拉兹），起飞后不久坠毁。爬升初期，一台发动机因结冰故障，导致事故。机上38名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: Near Point Barrow in Alaska, an Iñupiat hunter discovered three gray whales trapped in pack ice, which resulted in an international effort to free them
en.s: Operation Breakthrough was a US-Soviet effort to free three gray whales from pack ice in the Beaufort Sea near Point Barrow in the U.S. state of Alaska in 1988. The whales' plight generated media attention that led to the collaboration of multiple governments and organizations to free them. The youngest whale died during the effort and it is unknown if the remaining two whales ultimately survived.

zh.t: 阿拉斯加巴罗角附近，因纽皮雅特猎人发现三头被困在浮冰中的灰鲸，引发国际救援行动
zh.s: 1988年，美国和苏联共同开展“突破行动”，营救被困在美国阿拉斯加州巴罗角附近博福特海浮冰中的三头灰鲸。鲸群的困境引起媒体关注，促成多个政府和组织合作展开救援。最年轻的一头鲸在救援期间死亡；其余两头最终是否存活则不得而知。

en.s: The 2007 Zhani-Vedeno ambush occurred on 7 October when a convoy of vehicles carrying local Russian interior ministry soldiers and policemen was ambushed in the volatile Vedeno region of Chechnya. It was carried out under the command of Amir Aslambek, and was one of the deadliest attacks in several months.

en.s: The 2023 Australia Cup final was a soccer match played between A-League Men sides Sydney FC and Brisbane Roar at Allianz Stadium in Sydney on 7 October 2023. It was the 9th Australia Cup final. The venue was originally set at Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane, but was changed due to irrigation work. The match was refereed by Ben Abraham.

zh.s: 2023年澳大利亚杯决赛于10月7日在悉尼的安联体育场举行，由澳超球队悉尼FC对阵布里斯班狮吼。这是第9届澳大利亚杯决赛。比赛原定在布里斯班的桑科普体育场举行，后因灌溉工程更换场地。主裁判是本·亚伯拉罕。

The attacks, which began the ongoing Gaza war, were the first large-scale invasion of Israeli territory since the 1948 Arab–Israeli War.

zh.s: 2023年10月7日，哈马斯及其他几个巴勒斯坦武装组织从被封锁的加沙地带协调发动武装突袭，进入以色列南部的加沙边境地区，当天是犹太节日西赫托拉节。这些袭击引发了持续至今的加沙战争，也是自1948年阿以战争以来，以色列领土遭遇的首次大规模入侵。

en.s: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage.

zh.s: 加沙战争是发生在加沙地带和以色列的武装冲突，也是尚未解决的以巴冲突和加以冲突的一部分。战争始于2023年10月7日，当天巴勒斯坦武装组织哈马斯率先袭击以色列，造成1195名以色列人和外国公民死亡，另有251人被劫持为人质。

en.s: The battle of Re'im (Hebrew: קרב רעים; Arabic: معركة رعيم) took place on October 7, 2023, when Hamas attacked Israel, initiating the Gaza war. At 10:00 am, less than five hours after Hamas attacked, fighting was reported outside of the Re'im Army Base, which is headquarters for the Gaza Division. The base was reportedly the location of IDF drone and surveillance operations.

en.s: The kibbutz of Nahal Oz and the adjacent military base near the northern Gaza Strip were attacked in 2023 as part of the October 7 attacks. In the attack, more than 60 Israeli soldiers and 15 civilians were killed. Some soldiers and eight civilians were kidnapped and taken to the Gaza Strip. According to the IDF, several bodies were also taken to the Gaza Strip after being killed.

zh.s: 2023年10月7日袭击期间，哈马斯武装人员攻击了纳哈尔奥兹基布兹及加沙地带北部附近的军事基地。袭击造成60多名以色列士兵和15名平民死亡。一些士兵和8名平民被绑架到加沙地带。据以色列国防军称，另有数具遗体在死者遇难后被带到加沙地带。

en.s: On 7 October 2023, seven female Israeli tank crew members from the Caracal Battalion fought against Hamas militants continuously for 17 hours. The battle was the first instance in modern military history of an all-female armored unit taking part in combat. According to Israel, they killed 50 militants. The performance of the unit and other acts by Israeli female soldiers on 7 October impacted the way women were viewed in the IDF and in the integration of women in the army.

zh.s: 2023年10月7日，卡拉卡尔营的7名以色列女坦克兵与哈马斯武装人员持续交战17小时。这是现代军事史上首次有全女性装甲部队参战。据以色列方面称，她们击毙了50名武装人员。该部队以及其他以色列女兵在10月7日的行动，影响了人们对女性的看法，也影响了以色列国防军中女性的融入情况。

en.s: On 7 October 2024, the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) announced the removal of the Interim Regional Administration of Tigray (IRAT) President, Getachew Reda, and several other key officials from their positions in what was referred to as an internal coup within the regional leadership. The Interim Regional Administration of Tigray (IRAT) office of the president released a statement announcing that the TPLF declared a public coup.

en.s: A presidential election was held in Ethiopia on 7 October 2024 to elect its next president. Diplomat and outgoing minister of foreign affairs Taye Atske Selassie was elected without contest to a six-year term amid tensions between former president Sahle-Work Zewde and prime minister Abiy Ahmed.

zh.s: 2024年10月7日，埃塞俄比亚举行总统选举，选出下一任总统。外交官、即将卸任的外交部长塔耶·阿茨克-塞拉西在无人竞争的情况下当选，任期六年。当时，前总统萨赫勒-沃克·祖德与总理阿比·艾哈迈德之间关系紧张。
